note: Hamara Bagh ornamental catalog. Bloom and sowing windows are typical for the Pakistan plains and shift a few weeks in the north.

seasonal.label: Seasonal flowers
seasonal.tip: Winter/spring annuals: sow in the cool months and deadhead spent blooms to keep them flowering - most wrap up when the heat arrives.

perennial.label: Garden perennials
perennial.tip: Tough once established. Feed in spring and after the monsoon, and prune after each flush to keep the flowers coming.

rose.label: Roses
rose.tip: Prune hard in December-January and feed after every flush. Water at the base - wet leaves invite black spot.

bulb.label: Bulbs & corms
bulb.tip: Bulbs rot in soggy soil - use free-draining mix. Let the leaves yellow fully after bloom before cutting; that feeds next year's flowers.

fragrant.label: Fragrant & climbers
fragrant.tip: Plant near a window or your favourite sitting spot. Most love morning sun and a trellis, wall or railing to climb.

palm.label: Palms
palm.tip: Steady moisture while young, well-drained soil forever. Trim only fully brown fronds - the green ones are still feeding the palm.

indoor.label: Indoor favourites
indoor.tip: Bright indirect light suits most. Water less in winter and never let pots stand in water.

cactus.label: Cacti
cactus.tip: Full sun plus grit. Water deeply but only after the mix has been dry for days - overwatering kills more cacti than drought ever will.

succulent.label: Succulents
succulent.tip: Let the soil dry fully between waterings. In monsoon, move pots under shelter - rot is the real enemy, not thirst.

tree.label: Flowering trees
tree.tip: Plant in spring or at monsoon onset. Water deeply but infrequently once established - the roots will find their own way.

fruit.label: Fruit & orchard
fruit.tip: Plant in spring or at monsoon onset. Feed before flowering and after harvest, and thin young fruit for bigger, better quality.

native.label: Wild & native
native.tip: Local survivors: they already know Pakistan's seasons. Minimal fuss - water only through long dry spells.

flowers.name: Bird of Paradise
flowers.care: Needs 3-5 years of full sun before the first bird-shaped bloom - worth the wait.

flowers.name: Ranunculus
flowers.care: Soak the dry corms overnight before planting - they wake up much faster.

flowers.name: Hyacinth
flowers.care: In the plains, pre-chill bulbs in the fridge (not with fruit) for 4-6 weeks before planting for the best blooms.

flowers.name: Tulip
flowers.care: In the plains, pre-chill bulbs in the fridge (not with fruit) for 4-6 weeks before planting - tulips need that false winter.

flowers.name: Wisteria
flowers.care: Best in Islamabad, Murree and other cool spots - it sulks in the hot plains. Needs a strong pergola and years of patience.

flowers.name: Date Palm
flowers.care: A farm tree, not a pot plant - it wants deep ground and decades of blazing sun.

flowers.name: Christmas Cactus
flowers.care: Blooms best in a bright spot that cools down at night - water only when the top of the mix dries.

flowers.name: Lithops
flowers.care: Water only in autumn and spring - a resting lithops given summer water simply splits and dies.

flowers.name: Adenium (Desert Rose)
flowers.care: A rooftop star - loves blazing sun and hates wet feet. Let it dry out completely between waterings.

flowers.name: Henna (Mehndi)
flowers.care: Pick a sunny rooftop spot - henna turns into a fragrant little tree after a few cuts of 'mehndi' leaves.
